footnotes_as_printed.b: Compared with the standard through urea.

pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium through the vapour phase at the solutions' own vapour pressure)

value.what: NaCl molality (reference); empty where no NaCl cup was in the run

value2.what: KCl molality in isopiestic equilibrium with the other solutes of the same run line

composition.other_species: pure water solutions, one solute per cup (NaCl or KCl is the salt; H2SO4, sucrose, urea, glycerol are separate cups, not co-dissolved). All values of one run (the printed line plus its blank-Run duplicate line) are isopiestic with each other; duplicate-cup lines carry second final values for cups that had two cups with the same initial solution (p.3064).

extra_unmapped: Table IIa, IIb (smoothed osmotic coefficients) not extracted
H2SO4, Sucrose, Urea, Glycerol columns (separate-cup solutes in the same runs; molality per kg water)
notes: Layout kept as printed: one CSV row per printed line, six solute columns; a line with only some columns filled is a cup set lacking the others. Blank Run cell = second final value for the same run (duplicate cup). Superscript a/b recorded in note column. Molality is per kg water (text: moles per kg of water). H2SO4 has a molality column here but is out of the six-ion set. The value/value2 convention is a pair for the builder; the other solutes are listed in extra_unmapped. Pairing of a second-line value with its partners is by run, not by line (row 15 KCl 4.8051 has partners NaCl 4.1983 and urea 11.750 on the previous line).
quality_remarks: Saturation flags (note column): NaCl in runs 1 and 2, urea in run 4, KCl in run 3, sucrose in run 5 are saturated cups. Run 5 (footnote b) was compared with the standard through urea (no NaCl cup). Printed osmotic coefficients appear only in the smoothed Tables IIa/IIb (not extracted).
